verdict.rationale: Accessing files and repositories from other apps' sandboxes, such as file-provider or Files-app integration, is a fair question for a mobile developer client, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Mobile offers it. The documented features cover pull request review, issues, notifications, code search and Copilot agent tasks, all of which work on cloud-hosted repos, not on-device files shared across apps. A community user also notes it 'doesn't really seem to be a git client.'
